card.title: Show Me the Score
card.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?
